_subtitle.text: The best thing you’ve never heard.

_detail.text: Introducing the world’s best in-ear Active Noise Cancellation for the most immersive listening experience ever. Designed with an upgraded acoustic seal, AirPods Pro 3 automatically adapt to your environment and preferences. And new ultra-low-noise microphones remove even more unwanted sound. So you only hear what you want — in an unheard-of audio experience.

_name.text: Removes up to 2x more unwanted noise than AirPods Pro 2
Removes up to 4x more unwanted noise than original AirPods Pro

_image.alt: AirPods Pro 3, noise-cancelling microphone

_detail.text: Using advanced computational audio to remove more noise around you than ever, AirPods Pro 3 let you zone in (or out) when you need to. And five all-new ear tips — including an XXS option — fuse a thin layer of soft foam to the silicone shell to give you even better acoustic performance.

_image.alt: AirPods Pro 3, white color, noise-cancelling microphone, silicone tip, short stem

_detail.text: AirPods Pro 3 reduce background noise and isolate voices during calls. So whether you’re on the bus or in a café, every conversation is loud and clear.

_image.alt: A person wearing AirPods Pro 3 staring into their iPhone

_detail.text: AirPods Pro 3 combine Active Noise Cancellation with next-level Transparency, which makes your voice and the world around you sound even more natural and vibrant, intelligently adapting to your environment to prioritize what you need to hear, when you need to hear it.

_image.alt: Ambience sound waves as colorful arcs, top and bottom, text on center reads: Conversation Awareness

_detail.text: AirPods Pro 3 can detect when you’re talking to someone nearby and automatically lower the volume of whatever you’re listening to. When you’re done, the volume goes right back to where you had it.

_image.alt: AirPods Pro 3, left and right wireless headphones

_lines._intent: 音质章节：H2 芯片与重新设计的声学架构

_detail.text: Powered by the Apple-designed H2 chip, AirPods Pro 3 feature a completely redesigned acoustic architecture that brings breathtaking, all-around-you audio to everything you listen to — from your pump-up playlist to your weekly FaceTime call with family. A new multiport acoustic architecture with more precise airflow control — featuring an inward-facing microphone that points directly into the ear canal — delivers deeper bass, vivid vocal clarity, and a wider soundstage, so you never miss a note. A custom-built driver and amplifier work with the H2 chip to create high-definition, three-dimensional sound, with superlow distortion during playback.

_image.alt: AirPods Pro 3 inserted in the ear of a dancer as they enjoy a hands-free listening experience

_lines._intent: 个性化听感章节：自适应 EQ、个性化空间音频与动态头部追踪

_detail.text: AirPods Pro 3 feature next-generation Adaptive EQ, which customizes a sound signature for your unique ear geometry and fit. And Personalized Volume uses machine learning to understand your listening patterns and adapt to your preferences over time.
Adaptive EQ uses inward-facing microphones to tune music to your ears in real time. And with new Custom EQ, three intuitive controls let you easily personalize your perfect sound.
Personalized Spatial Audio uses the TrueDepth camera on your iPhone to create a custom profile based on the geometry of your head, delivering deeply immersive sound tailored to you.
Dynamic head tracking makes conversations feel like they’re happening in the same room — whether you’re gaming with friends or hosting a Group FaceTime call with family.

_image.alt: AirPods Pro 3, wireless headphone, white color, side exterior, short tubular stem, noise-canceling microphone

_lines._intent: 健身章节：心率传感、Fitness app 联动与 IP57 防护

_detail.text: All-new heart rate sensing helps you track your heart rate and calories burned during workouts. Using LEDs that pulse invisible light 256 times per second — and sensor fusion from the accelerometers — AirPods Pro 3 give you incredibly accurate data for up to 50 different workout types in the Fitness app. And with a more secure in-ear fit, you can go all out and they won’t come out.

With just AirPods Pro 3 and iPhone, you can dive into the new workout experience in the Fitness app, which includes things like walking, cycling, and HIIT. You can set your favorite music and podcasts to play automatically when you start a workout. With the new Apple Intelligence–enabled Workout Buddy feature, you can get personalized messages that keep you going. And with access to your Move ring — and even the Burn Bar in Fitness+ — you might just never stop.

_name.text: IP57 dust, sweat, and water resistance.

_detail.text: A first for AirPods, an IP57 rating means AirPods Pro 3 are more durable than ever. Thanks to precision engineering combined with robust testing, you can feel confident during even the sweatiest workouts.

_lines._intent: 听力健康章节：端到端听力健康体验的四个功能卡与了解入口

_subtitle.text: Check, aid, and help protect your hearing.

_detail.text: AirPods Pro 3 bring improvements to the world’s first end-to-end hearing health experience. Now you can take a scientifically validated Hearing Test in a broader range of background conditions. The Hearing Aid feature adds improved voice clarity, automatic Conversation Boost, and 67 percent more battery life in Transparency on a single charge. And active Hearing Protection helps prevent exposure to loud environmental noise.

_image.alt: Lightning bolt, green background

_summary.text: 4 more hours for the Hearing Aid feature

_detail.text: Hearing Aid users now get 67 percent more battery life in Transparency on a single charge. That’s a total of up to 10 hours, making it easier than ever to use this breakthrough capability morning, noon, and night.

_image.alt: A person wearing AirPods Pro 3, laughing in conversation with another person, both holding a cup of coffee

_detail.text: Now when you’re having a conversation in a busy restaurant or office, Conversation Boost will automatically amplify the voice of the person you’re talking to while minimizing the distracting noises around you. And with the new microphones, transducer, and amplifier, your voice will sound clearer and more natural than ever.

_image.alt: Blue circular sound ripple

_detail.text: With a better fit and increased noise cancellation, you can now take a scientifically validated Hearing Test in a broader range of everyday background conditions — from the comfort of your home. And if you have mild to moderate hearing loss, you can use the improved Hearing Aid feature wherever you go.

_image.alt: Blue bars indicating levels of Hearing Protection

_detail.text: In addition to passive noise reduction from the ear tips, active Hearing Protection helps prevent exposure to loud environmental noise. Machine learning on the H2 chip reduces noise 48,000 times per second while maintaining natural and vibrant sound for whatever you’re listening to.
